# Drosophila melanogaster: Species Guidance

Drosophila is diploid with sex chromosomes and extensive population-genetic
resources. In D. melanogaster, meiotic recombination occurs in females but not
males, so a sex-averaged random-recombination default can be biologically
wrong. State sex-specific maps, inversion handling, and whether samples are
inbred lines, natural isolates, or experimental crosses.
